identity: Ossuary Reach shelves and labels the Throng's bones; the Gravewood is waking around the archive and a skeleton calling itself the Marrow Archivist is re-filing the dead under its own name.

quests.title: Misfiled in a Wolf
quests.text: Briarpack Blightfang Wolves prowl the {name:bonewood} {dir_of:r20_anchor_020:bonewood} by day, carrying off bones that ought to be on my shelves. Kill eight before more of our ancestors disappear into their dens. I have seen unfamiliar labels dangling from their mouths; apparently I now have a rival archivist as well as a wolf problem.
quests.lesson: A daytime pack hunt in the bone forest.

quests.title: Paper Remembers
quests.text: Mereth Rubbinghand at Boneledger Post copies the names on our barrow stones before weather can take another letter. Go and speak with Mereth; those rubbings may tell us why the names on my shelves no longer agree with the graves. Stone was supposed to be the durable option, but I have learned to keep a second copy.
quests.lesson: Travel to the zone's second hub.

quests.title: Optional: The Trees Have Taken to Walking
quests.text: The Lichen Gravewood Treants in the {name:bonewood} spend their nights walking through the burial rows, dragging roots across generations of careful work. Fell eight after dark, and watch for the Grave-Web Bonelurker Spiders among them. I planted trees to shade the dead; I never expected to have to explain that they should stay beside the graves.
quests.lesson: The same area's night roster: treants with a spider minor role.

quests.title: Under the New Names
quests.text: The stones of the {name:barrow_ridge}, which lies {dir_of:r20_anchor_038:barrow_ridge}, carry fresh names cut over older letters. Barrow Skeleton Archers guard them at night; destroy eight so I can get close enough to make rubbings. I can work around weather, but arrows make a dreadful mess of the paper.
quests.lesson: A night hunt against ranged undead.

quests.title: Optional: A Hand I Might Recognise
quests.text: Bring me three Etched Bone from the Barrow Skeleton Archers on the {name:barrow_ridge} after dark. I need to compare the lettering with my rubbings to learn who has been changing the names. A thief may borrow someone else's name, but usually keeps their own bad handwriting.
quests.lesson: A drop request that shares the archer outing.

quests.title: A Chisel Leaves Its Signature
quests.text: Those new letters were cut with a miner's chisel, and the scratches may tell us more than the words. Go to Memoryvein Dig and speak with Neris Fossilhand, who knows the tools used in the Reach. I trust Neris to recognise the workmanship, even if the owner would prefer to remain uncredited.
quests.lesson: Travel to the zone's third hub.

quests.title: Optional: Disturbing the Workings
quests.text: Bonewood Plaguehide Bears dig into the old shafts in the {name:webwood}, which lies {zone_area:webwood}, by day, helping themselves to the marrow. Kill eight before they bring more of the workings down. I have watched the Marrow Archivist gather what they leave behind; the bears do the digging and it takes the credit, which is a familiar arrangement.
quests.lesson: Heavy daytime animals beside the climax's story.

quests.title: Optional: Hold Up the Past
quests.text: Smelt six Steel Bars and bring them here to Memoryvein Dig for the shaft supports. There are still names down there we have not read, and the timbers have begun making persuasive arguments for leaving. I have been buried once already; next time, I would prefer to make an appointment.
quests.lesson: Tier-three metal from the Reach's own rock.

quests.title: Filed Under Theft
quests.text: You will find the {name:marrow_archivist} in the {name:deepwood} {dir_from_giver:marrow_archivist}, giving every bone it collects the same name: its own. Kill it, and destroy four Grave-Web Bonelurker Spiders in that wood at night. Those people had names long before it found a use for them. I intend to see those names stay theirs.
quests.lesson: The heartland's climax: a named normal leader at the top of the zone.

quests.title: Ashveil Keeps Its Own Records
quests.text: The Reach can file its own dead again; the living are needed elsewhere. Go to Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise and report to Vaska Ashlistener, who holds that ground for the Throng against the Accord. Tell Vaska the Archivist is closed, and that I would like the stones there left as they were carved.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff from the heartland to the faction's contested zones.

quests.title: Repeatable: Teeth in the Catalogue
quests.text: Briarpack Blightfang Wolves hunt the {name:ashfields}, which lies {zone_area:ashfields}, after dark, and I cannot keep revising the catalogue to account for digestion. Kill six and report back. This task is available again twenty minutes after you hand it in; the shelves will stay labelled, even if I have to keep filling them.
